scope.selectionRule: Include every C2-LT-B1 sourceTaskFreshReviews row whose artifactPromotionDecision is not eligible-for-bounded-artifact-fill.
scope.resolutionRule: Prepare corrected, current or source-specific candidates only; do not create reviewed artifacts until a new independent fresh review marks a corrected row eligible.
nonClaims: This register does not change any prior reviewer verdict.
This register does not create reviewed artifacts for blocked rows.
This register does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, clinical recommendation, intervention ranking, domain-claim upgrade or individual death-date output.
This register does not mark C2-LT-B1 fully closed; it prepares remediation inputs for the 6 non-eligible rows.
